Vocabulary.summary: Provides features for creating, deleting, updating, and querying hotword vocabularies.

vocabularyName.description: The hotword Table Name. This field is required during Creation.

vocabulary.description: Hotword list. This parameter is required during creation. You can add up to 500 words per hotword list.

text.description: Hotword text. Each hotword must not exceed 15 Chinese characters or 7 English words. If the hotword contains both Chinese and English, the total number of Chinese characters and English letters must not exceed 15.

lang.description:
Language of the hotword.  
- zh: Chinese  
- en: English

type.description:
The type of hotword. If you need to use hotwords of types such as contact in a dialog system, you must set this value. Otherwise, if you only need to use hotwords in an ASR job, you can set this value to null or an empty string.  
- contact_name: contact

vocabularyId.description: The hotword ID. This field is required for update or delete operations.

vocabularyIds.description: List of hotword IDs. This parameter is required for queries.

vocabularyId.description: Hotword ID. This UUID is generated during creation and can be passed in when establishing a conversation connection.

vocabularys.description: List of hotwords. When the request is a query operation, this field contains the hotword list retrieved based on the provided hotword ID list.

vocabularyName.description: Hotword list name. This return value is null if no corresponding hotword is found.

modifiedTime.description: Latest update time of the hotword vocabulary. This return value is null if the corresponding hotword cannot be found.

vocabulary.description: Hotword. Latest update time of the hotword vocabulary. This return value is null if the corresponding hotword cannot be found.

Vocabulary.title: Hotword Management
Vocabulary.responseParamsDescription:
When the request succeeds, the status code in the response is 200.  
If the status code is not 200, the request failed. You can view the error message in the message field. The following are common error responses:  
+ Vocabulary not found error (The specified hotword ID does not exist or does not belong to this Alibaba Cloud account)  
+ Vocabulary size too large (The number of hotwords in the vocabulary exceeds the limit)  
+ Vocabulary format invalid (The hotword format is invalid, such as excessive hotword length)  
+ Internal vocabulary error (Other types of hotword-related errors)
